criteria.name: Fetchability
criteria.pass_test: Each intended landing page returns a usable 200 HTML response after legitimate redirects; exclude deliberate removals.

criteria.name: Index eligibility
criteria.pass_test: Each intended landing page is allowed for Googlebot and has no noindex or contradictory blocking header. Eligibility is not proof of indexing.

criteria.name: Canonical consistency
criteria.pass_test: Each sampled duplicate/variant set resolves or signals one relevant preferred URL; canonical targets work and signals do not conflict. Missing self-canonical alone is not failure.

criteria.name: Internal discovery
criteria.pass_test: Each intended page is reachable through a crawlable internal anchor from its relevant hub; tested internal links resolve to intended content. No arbitrary click-depth rule.

criteria.name: Page meaning
criteria.pass_test: Each landing page has a descriptive title and clear main heading consistent with its content and intent. Multiple H1s alone are not failure.

criteria.name: Useful content
criteria.pass_test: For each frozen user task, the mapped page provides the requested information without a demonstrable material omission, misleading claim, or obstructive interstitial. State the missing task detail for failure.

criteria.name: Mobile usability
criteria.pass_test: Each representative template at a recorded mobile viewport has readable main content and usable navigation with no content-obscuring overlap or unintended horizontal scroll.

criteria.name: Core Web Vitals
criteria.pass_test: One unit per available field metric/device/URL or origin: p75 LCP <=2500ms, INP <=200ms, CLS <=0.1. Missing metrics unknown; never substitute lab TBT for INP.

criteria.name: Structured data integrity
criteria.pass_test: Each present markup block parses, matches visible facts, and meets current required properties for the claimed supported feature. Absent markup is NA unless an agreed feature goal requires it.

criteria.name: Discovery signals
criteria.pass_test: Each sitemap entry sampled is a preferred live indexable URL; each applicable hreflang set uses valid reciprocal locale references. No sitemap/hreflang requirement for a simple single-language site.

criteria.name: Direct answer
criteria.pass_test: Each frozen question has an explicit answer on its mapped page; cite the question and answer location. A missing mapped answer is failure only after inspecting the mapped page.

criteria.name: Extractable text
criteria.pass_test: Each mapped answer exists as selectable text in fetched or rendered DOM rather than only an image, inaccessible embed, or unavailable interaction.

criteria.name: Answer structure
criteria.pass_test: Each mapped answer is associated with a descriptive heading or semantic list/table appropriate to its question; no compulsory FAQ format or fixed word count.

criteria.name: Answer precision
criteria.pass_test: Each mapped answer states the units, conditions, audience or limitations needed to interpret that question correctly. Log the exact missing qualifier for failure.

criteria.name: Follow-up completeness
criteria.pass_test: Each frozen follow-up task has a working route to its relevant explanation or next action. No need to add irrelevant FAQ pages.

criteria.name: Retrieval controls
criteria.pass_test: For each agreed search/grounding engine, sampled intended pages have no documented access or reuse restriction contradicting the owner goal. Inspect current official bot/control documentation first; ordinary fetch success cannot prove bot access.

criteria.name: Entity consistency
criteria.pass_test: Each sampled organization/product fact agrees across visible pages and present structured data (name, offering, contact, price/units where applicable). Unchecked external profiles unknown.

criteria.name: Traceable evidence
criteria.pass_test: Each frozen material factual claim has an identifiable primary reference, attributable first-party evidence/method, or appropriate expert responsibility. Unsupported external truth is unknown, not automatically false.

criteria.name: Citable context
criteria.pass_test: Each frozen evidence passage identifies its subject and attaches the date, scope or methodology needed to reuse it accurately; cite a concrete ambiguity for failure.

criteria.name: Maintenance transparency
criteria.pass_test: Each time-sensitive sampled fact has an accurate applicable date/version/validity context and no confirmed contradiction with its cited primary source. Static evergreen facts do not need update dates.
